title: Keep eligible rows and total consistent
outcome: The synthetic HTTP API returns only active in-stock items for the server tenant, with total computed before pagination
scope: Existing predicate, query and HTTP handler
nonGoals: No UI, authentication provider, pricing logic, persistence or deployment
invariants: Count and rows derive from the same filtered set
Client query cannot select another tenant
authority: Read/write synthetic fixture and execute its local tests only

decisions.question: Where should filtering live?
decisions.choice: Reuse the domain predicate before pagination
